title: HR SOP Outline for Small Business Owners
goal: Create an HR standard operating procedure (SOP) outline for small business owners with little or no SOP-writing expertise, then extend it with two self-added bonus deliverables, using Claude alongside Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
occupation: Founder and Co-CEO, and AI Domain Expert Contractor

Step 1.step_name: Determine Small Business HR SOP Best Practices
Step 1.step_action: Ask Claude to find helpful hints for small business owners with little or no expertise in writing SOP manuscripts. Claude will then create a document related to this.

nodes.label: Request small-business HR SOP best practices
nodes.detail: The participant uploads three PDF guides and asks Claude to analyze and determine small-business HR SOP best practices for owners with little or no SOP-writing expertise, including ancillary sources beyond the uploaded files.

nodes.label: Research and compile a Small Business HR Playbook
nodes.detail: Claude reviews the three uploaded guides, researches additional HR policy and compliance sources, and compiles a Word Small Business HR Playbook containing a policy library, drafting process, reusable SOP template, compliance reference table, and 90-day roadmap.

nodes.label: Queue a follow-up request for a PDF version while Claude works
nodes.detail: While Claude is still researching, the participant types and queues a follow-up message asking Claude to also create a PDF file of the small-business HR SOP best practices, then watches Claude's progress.

nodes.label: Preview the Word playbook
nodes.detail: The participant opens the delivered Word playbook in Claude's preview panel and skims its title page and summary while the queued PDF request is sent.

nodes.label: Deliver a PDF version of the playbook
nodes.detail: Claude converts the playbook into a PDF with the same content as the Word version (policy library, 8-step SOP-writing process, template, rollout best practices, compliance table, and sources) for easier sharing and printing.

nodes.label: Review the playbook in Word and the PDF in Acrobat
nodes.detail: The participant opens the Word playbook and the PDF version, and reads through the PDF in Acrobat down to the sources and legal-advice note.

user_response.label: adopt
user_response.reasoning: save claude's Word playbook and open without change

Step 2.step_action: Ask Claude to generate a report related to small business SOP formatting options.

nodes.label: Request an SOP formatting report and an HR best-practices Word document
nodes.detail: The participant attaches a PDF guide and asks Claude for a report on small-business SOP formatting options that considers the PDF, plus a Microsoft Word document on HR industry best practices for formatting SOPs.

nodes.label: Research SOP formatting options and generate two reference documents
nodes.detail: Claude researches SOP structure and storage options, verifies the uploaded PDF, and produces two downloadable files: a Markdown report comparing small-business SOP formatting options and a Word guide covering HR SOP writing best practices, reusable templates, and a worked example.

nodes.label: Save the Word best-practices guide and read it in Word
nodes.detail: The participant clicks Download and open on the HR SOP Formatting Best Practices Word guide, saves it to the computer as HR_SOP_Formatting_Best_Practices, and reads through it in Word using the navigation pane; the Markdown formatting-options report is not opened in this step.

user_response.label: adopt
user_response.reasoning: adopt the formatting best practice guide

Step 3.step_action: Ask Claude to create a QC file for a company to best QC SOP manuscripts in the future.

nodes.label: Request an Excel QC toolkit built from Steps 1 and 2
nodes.detail: The participant asks Claude to create a quality-control file a company can use to QC future SOP manuscripts, using the findings from Step 1 (SOP best practices) and Step 2 (SOP formatting options) as input, delivered as a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet.

nodes.label: Develop and validate an SOP quality control workbook
nodes.detail: Claude integrates the findings from Steps 1 and 2 into an Excel QC workbook with 43 criteria across seven categories, automated scoring, dropdowns, a QC review log, a formatting reference, and a scoring rubric. It tests the formulas with sample data and delivers the completed workbook.

nodes.label: Save and review the QC toolkit in Excel
nodes.detail: The participant opens the SOP_QC_Toolkit workbook in Excel, saves it to the session's project folder, and looks through its tabs (Instructions, QC Checklist, Format Decision Reference, Scoring Rubric).

Step 4.step_name: Create a Draft Email to the CEO About the SOP Project
Step 4.step_action: Ask Claude to create a draft email to notify the CEO about the HR SOP initiative.

nodes.label: Request a draft CEO progress email in Word
nodes.detail: The participant asks Claude to draft an email to the CEO about the progress and content of the SOP project, covering Steps 1 through 3, as a Microsoft Word document.

nodes.label: Draft the CEO update email
nodes.detail: Claude delivers a Word draft email with bracketed placeholders, summarizing Steps 1-3, a deliverables table listing all files produced so far, the value of the project, and recommended next steps with a soft call to action.

nodes.label: Review the draft email in Word
nodes.detail: The participant opens the draft email in Word, saves it as Draft_CEO_Email_SOP_Project_Update, and reads through the Step 3 section and the Deliverables Produced table.

user_response.label: adopt
user_response.reasoning: save the drafted ceo update email

Step 5.step_action: Ask Claude to summarize all prior steps and develop an Executive Summary to explain the SOP project to key company stakeholders.

nodes.label: Request a stakeholder executive summary in Word
nodes.detail: The participant asks Claude to summarize Steps 1 to 4 into an Executive Summary (EXSUM) explaining the SOP project to key company stakeholders, as a Microsoft Word document.

nodes.label: Draft the stakeholder EXSUM
nodes.detail: Claude delivers a 4-page Word EXSUM opening with a Bottom Line Up Front (BLUF), followed by purpose and background, a four-step approach table, step details, a consolidated deliverables table, value to the organization, recommendations and next steps, and a conclusion.

nodes.label: Review the EXSUM in Word
nodes.detail: The participant opens the EXSUM, saves it to the session's project folder as 'Step 5_Ultimate Deliverable_HR SOP Project_Executive Summary', and walks through it section by section in Word using the navigation pane, down to the conclusion.

Step 6.step_name: Create an EXSUM for a Fractional HR Manager or Executive
Step 6.step_action: Ask Claude to create an Executive update format for an HR Manager working for a short-time period within an organization.

nodes.label: Request a similar EXSUM in PDF for a fractional HR executive
nodes.detail: The participant thanks Claude and asks for a similar EXSUM in PDF format aimed at a fractional HR Executive or Manager, so that person knows how such a file should be structured.

nodes.label: Adapt the EXSUM for a fractional HR lead
nodes.detail: Claude delivers a 5-page PDF EXSUM re-targeted to a fractional HR Executive/Manager, adding an anatomy table after the header that explains what each section does, with ownership-transition framing and light tone shifts.

nodes.label: Review the fractional-lead EXSUM
nodes.detail: The participant reads Claude's summary of the fractional-lead EXSUM and briefly previews the delivered PDF in Claude's side panel.

Step 7.step_name: Craft a Self-Learning and Development (L&D) Plan for an Independent Contractor
Step 7.step_action: Ask Claude to craft a new self-learning plan for a freelance business owner with an MBA and 10 years of prior HR service in the government, seeking contract work opportunities in the HR field.

nodes.label: Request an L&D slide deck for an HR career changer
nodes.detail: The participant asks Claude for a PowerPoint Learning and Development presentation for a freelance independent contractor with an MBA and 10 years of government HR experience who wants to expand their business into HR.

nodes.label: Develop and validate an HR consulting career roadmap presentation
nodes.detail: Claude develops a 14-slide career-transition presentation covering transferable HR skills, credentials, consulting services, and a four-phase roadmap. It creates custom icons, adds speaker notes, renders slides for visual inspection, fixes layout issues, and delivers the validated PowerPoint.

nodes.label: Save earlier deliverables and re-check the EXSUM PDF while Claude builds the deck
nodes.detail: While Claude builds the deck, the participant saves the previously generated files into the session's project folder in File Explorer, re-opens the fractional-lead EXSUM PDF in Acrobat, and then watches Claude's progress.

nodes.label: Download and open the finished deck
nodes.detail: The participant clicks Download and open on the finished 14-slide deck, which opens in PowerPoint saved to the computer as HR_Consulting_LD_Roadmap, and browses the slides, including the four-phase 'Your Learning & Development Roadmap' slide.
